bio: Molly is a producer, digital strategist, tinkerer, and occasional writer. She helps projects find their shape — by trade she gets things made, for pleasure she makes them. Over a decade in San Francisco doing very San Francisco things: employee twelve at a scrappy startup, ad agency life, global digital campaigns at Apple, getting scolded by AI. You can currently find her working on notion.com.

personas.label: Producing
personas.name: Producer
personas.headline: Getting dots in a row
personas.blurb: Turning a big vague idea into a crisp plan—and then actually shipping it.
personas.longVersion: By day, Molly turns big, vague ideas into dated plans with names next to things — scoping, budgeting, and herding design, eng, and legal toward a launch that actually ships. A decade of it: employee twelve at a scrappy startup, agency life, global campaigns at Apple, and now building at notion.com.

Calm in the week-of, which is the whole job

personas.blurb: Making something small and slightly impractical, probably as a gift, probably unfinished.
personas.longVersion: Off the clock, Molly makes small, slightly impractical things — hand-bound books with wobbly bindings, blended spices and fresh-baked bread, dusty charcoal figure drawings, and a drawer of works in progress she is entirely unrepentant about.
